title: COI Profile Configuration
description: Schema for Code on Incus (COI) profile config.toml files

context.description: Path to context .md file (resolved relative to profile directory)

model.description: AI model name to use in this profile

forward_env.description: Host environment variable names to forward into the container

environment.description: Environment variables to set inside the container. Empty string value clears an inherited key.

mounts.description: Additional host directories to mount into the container

persistent.description: Reuse the container across sessions instead of creating a fresh one

storage_pool.description: Incus storage pool to use for this container

alias.description: Human-readable alias for the workspace container

BuildConfig.description: Instructions for building a custom container image

script.description: Path to a build shell script (relative to profile directory or absolute)

commands.description: Inline build commands as an alternative to a script file

count.description: Number of CPUs or pinned range, e.g. "2" or "0-3". Empty means unlimited.

allowance.description: CPU time allowance as a percentage or time slice, e.g. "50%" or "25ms/100ms"

limit.description: Maximum memory, e.g. "512MiB", "2GiB", "50%". Empty means unlimited.

swap.description: Swap space, e.g. "true", "false", or a size like "1GiB"

read.description: Read throughput limit, e.g. "10MiB/s" or "1000iops". Empty means unlimited.

write.description: Write throughput limit, e.g. "5MiB/s" or "500iops". Empty means unlimited.

max_duration.description: Maximum session duration, e.g. "2h", "30m", "1h30m". Empty means unlimited.

max_processes.description: Maximum number of processes (0 means unlimited)

auto_stop.description: Automatically stop the container when the duration limit is reached

stop_graceful.description: Use graceful shutdown instead of force-kill when stopping

binary.description: Binary name to execute. Defaults to the tool name if not set.

permission_mode.description: Permission mode: "bypass" (default) skips interactive prompts; "interactive" prompts the user

context_file.description: Path to a custom context Markdown file injected into the tool (supports ~ expansion)

auto_context.description: Automatically inject the COI sandbox context into the tool's native system (default: true)

effort_level.description: Thinking effort level passed to Claude. Empty means the user controls it interactively.

container.description: Absolute path inside the container where the host path is mounted

mode.description: Network isolation mode: "open" (unrestricted), "restricted" (internet only, no LAN), or "allowlist" (explicit domain list only)

block_private_networks.description: Block access to RFC 1918 private network ranges

block_metadata_endpoint.description: Block access to cloud instance metadata endpoints (e.g. 169.254.169.254)

allowed_domains.description: Domains allowed when mode is "allowlist". RFC 1918 ranges are always blocked in allowlist mode.

refresh_interval_minutes.description: How often to refresh DNS-resolved allowlist rules (minutes)

allow_local_network_access.description: Allow established connections from the entire local network, not just the gateway

path.description: Path to the network log file

PathsConfig.description: Filesystem path overrides for COI data directories

preserve_workspace_path.description: Mount the workspace at the same absolute path as the host (e.g. /home/user/project) instead of /workspace

project.description: Incus project to use for containers

group.description: Unix group with access to the Incus socket

code_uid.description: UID of the 'code' user inside containers

code_user.description: Username of the unprivileged user inside containers (default: "code")

disable_shift.description: Disable UID shifting. Required for Colima/Lima environments that do not support idmapped mounts.

writable_hooks.description: Allow the container to write to .git/hooks (default: false — hooks are mounted read-only)

forward_agent.description: Forward the host SSH agent into the container (default: false)

protected_paths.description: Workspace-relative paths to mount read-only. Replaces the defaults when set.

additional_protected_paths.description: Extra paths to protect in addition to the defaults

disable_protection.description: Disable all read-only path protection (not recommended)

host_immutable.description: Apply the Linux immutable attribute (chattr +i) to protected paths on the host before container start. Prevents the unshare+umount bypass. Default: true.

MonitoringConfig.description: Security monitoring and threat response settings

auto_pause_on_high.description: Automatically pause the container when a high-severity threat is detected

auto_kill_on_critical.description: Automatically kill the container when a critical-severity threat is detected

poll_interval_sec.description: How often to collect container stats (seconds)

file_read_threshold_mb.description: Alert when the container reads more than this many MB in a single poll interval

file_read_rate_mb_per_sec.description: Alert when the sustained file read rate exceeds this threshold (MB/s)

audit_log_retention_days.description: Number of days to retain audit log files

rate_limit_per_second.description: Maximum number of nftables log entries per second (default: 100)

dns_query_threshold.description: Alert when DNS queries per minute exceed this threshold (default: 100)

lima_host.description: Lima VM host name for macOS environments, e.g. "lima-default"

mode.description: Timezone source: "host" (mirror the host timezone), "fixed" (use a specific IANA zone), or "utc"

name.description: IANA timezone name to use when mode is "fixed", e.g. "America/New_York"

use_tmux.description: Run the tool inside a tmux session (default: true)
